performers: Dani & Debora Gurgel Quarteto feat. Sandy Cressman & Natalie Cressman
events.description: Samba Jazz from Sao Paulo Brazil The hypnotic energy of Dani & Debora Gurgel Quarteto comes from the deep musical connection between Dani Gurgel and Debora Gurgel. Dani's syncopated scat singing blends with Debora's pulsating piano, weaving Brazilian charm and jazz improvisation into a vibrant and original sound. The group — affectionately known as DDG4 [...]
